name: City of London
notes: Schedule 3 of the Building Safety Levy (England) Regulations 2025 lists Inner Temple and Middle Temple separately from the City of London. Both lie within this district and have the same rates.

name: Inner Temple
notes: Inner Temple has its own entry in Schedule 3 of the Building Safety Levy (England) Regulations 2025 but is not a local authority district. It lies within the City of London district (E09000001), so local-authority-district is blank. Its rates are the same as the City of London's.
